project_overview: This project appears to be a complex educational management system, likely handling student admissions, course selection, and reporting. The codebase utilizes a layered architecture, with distinct components for user interfaces (Views) and backend services. The project exhibits a high degree of interconnectedness between different modules, suggesting a need for careful architectural review. Potential vulnerabilities arise from the depth of prop drilling and dependencies between components.

layers.description: Responsible for the presentation layer and user interactions.
Handles data processing, API interactions, and core application logic.
Provides foundational support and utility functions.

macro_trends.title: Deep Prop-Drilling and Component Coupling
macro_trends.description: Several components, particularly UI components like ResultPage.vue and SelectedApplicationService.vue, exhibit deep prop-drilling, potentially increasing coupling and making the system less maintainable.  This creates a high risk for architectural fragility.

macro_trends.title: Centralized State Management Concerns
macro_trends.description: The reliance on shared state across multiple components, especially in UI components, could lead to inconsistencies and difficult debugging.  Lack of strict state management practices is a concern.

key_workflows.name: Student Admission Workflow
key_workflows.description: This workflow involves receiving application data, validating the information, generating reports, and ultimately determining student eligibility – heavily dependent on the SelectedApplicationService for data manipulation and rules.

key_workflows.name: Course Selection & Reporting
key_workflows.description: This workflow focuses on student course selection, generating reports related to enrollment, and utilizes components like ResultPage.vue to display results.
